name: Yoga school in Edinburgh
reason: No usable school found in three searches. Meadowlark Yoga (Argyle Place, which ran 200hr trainings) is gone: meadowlarkyoga.com now redirects to an unrelated gymnastics club, so nothing was fetched. Other results were directories or listings (BookRetreats, Cademy, Yoga Alliance, Hoop) or single teachers, with no Edinburgh studio's own site showing a current teacher training. Directories were not used as sources.
